MEASURED, DECISIVE: enemy perception ignores the entire stealth model. An INFANTRY at 8 m reaches AGGRO at f=30 (0.50 s) identically at V=0.6669 (lit, standing, heavy) and V=0.05 (unlit, crouched, Sneak 100, in cover). Item expects 1.03 s and 26.7 s. Alert fills +4/frame whenever d<=sight_radius; at 30 m nothing. It is a radius+cone check. RI-STL01 method 4 (no proximity leak) fails live: AGGRO at 1.0 m in the dark.

MEASURED: the CIVILIAN model IS real and wired — light 10.7x V ratio gives 10.4x faster CHALLENGE; contextWeight 3.0/1.6 gives 1.86x (expect 1.875); 15 m vs 8 m never reaches CHALLENGE; civ facing away stays at 0; naga/saxhleel/imperial 1.49x and 1.69x (expect 1.481 and 1.687).

MEASURED: continuous movement sound is consumed by nobody. r_effective 36.31 m, civilian 2 m away facing away, 10 s of sprinting heavy on dry reed -> suspicion 0.00. The 4 discrete scripted events DO work (pick_break +54 at 3 m). alert_channel is absent from the enemy trace record.
MEASURED: no search behaviour in the world. Enemy at AGGRO, player 60 m away: alert 100->0 in 2 s, speed 0.0 for 24 s, never leaves its spawn anchor, zone_baseline_alert stays 0.

MEASURED, DECISIVE: the witness predicate is never evaluated against the world. A civilian 3 m away in daylight at contextWeight 3.00 and civ_state ALARM watches takeObject() -> witnesses: [], witnesses_pending 0, bounty 0. Crime record is created (landed:false) but can never land. Every witness in the build is hand-created by addWitness().

MEASURED: saveState().crime.stolen_registry is [] after three thefts, and the taken items never enter saveState().inventory. RI-STL02 method 2 (stolen_from in saveState and surviving a round trip) fails.

MEASURED, SURVIVES: locks. Gate refuses below Security req with 0 picks; W = 4.00/12.25/20.50/34.00 and clamped at 34.0; live collar opened on 3 timed interact presses; RNG counter moved by 0 across the whole interaction. Ward angles authored: 719 angles, chi2 226.1 on 35 df, 0 duplicate vectors, 0 length mismatches, 59/59 tier-4/5 with alt_routes. Tier-1 locks: 0 in the world (item expects ~410).

MEASURED, SURVIVES: S21's pickpocket die. 60 seeds x 5 Sneak levels: 300/300 attempts draw exactly once; notice_chance 0.357/0.278/0.209/0.137/0.070 at Sneak 5/25/45/70/100 with caught 19/17/15/8/6 of 60. The die is drawn and it matters.

MEASURED: property data is excellent. 1878 objects, 100% owner key, 100% owner != null, 292 distinct owners, 0% single-owner interiors, 233 trespass zones in 7 classes, >=28 per settlement, SNUFFABLE 71.5%.
MEASURED: reset() and loadState() do not clear the stealth/crime subsystem — bounty 777, context, civilians and suspicion all survive both. Scenario isolation defect.
